kind_of_thing.quote: Bamboos are a diverse group of mostly evergreen perennial flowering plants making up the subfamily Bambusoideae of the grass family Poaceae.

kind_of_plant.quote: Bamboo is a name for over 1,400 species of giant grasses in 115 different genera.

extinct.why: The sources describe bamboo as a living, growing plant with many species, so it is still living.
